The Zusor Banzu Institute was founded in 1952. The Zusor Banzu Institute is headquartered in Sorailost. It was founded by Pellor Ostvenlor. It employs 810 researchers. It operates 31 laboratories. Its annual budget is 439 million crowns. Its governance includes an independent advisory board. Its current director is Thesor Kagarzu. The current director took office in 2017. Visitors can tour parts of the main building by appointment. It opened a satellite campus in Elkalor. The satellite campus opened in 2014. It holds 622 patents. 45% of its funding comes from private donors. Its journal, the Fenfen Review, publishes 5 issues a year. Its main partner university is in Nyelny. The organisation publishes an annual report describing its activities. It has won the Zurom Prize 18 times. It trains 77 doctoral students each year.
